neighbours.label: the token '-v': a hyphen glued to the start of a word beginning with v ('high-|voltage', 'non-|virulent', 'bluish-|violet')
fire: The workers repaired a damaged low-voltage cable near the plant.
Doctors gave the sick child a multi-vitamin with breakfast.
The moth has dark wings with reddish-violet spots.
The firm makes non-volatile memory for small devices.
She bought an anti-virus program for the office computers.
Investors fled the high-volatility shares during the crash.
The clinic treats non-viral infections of the liver.
The anti-vaccine group marched along the road on Monday.
